checks.proof: EffectiveConfigResolver.v1 is the only reader/normalizer/provenance authority for engine and command entrypoints; EffectiveConfigProvenanceState is the only planning/resume authority; EffectiveConfigReport is a deterministic human-readable projection finalized immutable; logs are telemetry-only and can never alter planning, invalidation, state, report or resume. single_result_rule hands every entrypoint the same accepted ResolverResult.
checks.oracle: Delete, corrupt, reorder or alter reports/logs: planning, invalidation, state and resume are unchanged because state is sole authority.

checks.proof: Per-run state holds exactly one current snapshot plus a monotonic ring capped at 32 invalidation/fallback events (only durable event kinds). The atomic publication unit appends the candidate event and drops only the minimum seq when ring length=32; overflow example: events 1..32 plus seq 33 commit ring 2..33 with snapshot unchanged except generation/report projection. Telemetry EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_RING_EVICTED observes; never authors state.
checks.oracle: 33 concurrent events retain exactly the newest 32 monotonic entries, evict exactly one oldest atomically, and recovery stays snapshot-only.

checks.proof: ordered_steps[7] publishes current_snapshot, ring append/eviction, state_generation/state_hash, report reference and report_projection_hash in one CAS transaction (expected generation -> expected+1) with atomic rename/commit_id, or publishes none. A loser rereads authoritative state and retries only while resolver identity remains valid, else returns EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_STATE_CAS_CONFLICT or EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_IDENTITY_DRIFT. Crash injection at any publication boundary accepts only checksum-valid monotonic state.
checks.oracle: Crash at every CAS/snapshot/report/eviction boundary yields a single valid winner; no torn snapshot/ring/report mixture is ever visible.

checks.proof: Report content is a deterministic projection of accepted state bound by report_projection_hash over canonical inputs (no timestamps/secrets/raw values); finalization is immutable; regeneration from unchanged state is byte-identical.
checks.oracle: Permute map/key/event arrival order and require byte-identical state, report and hashes.

checks.proof: valid_state validation covers schema, canonical state_hash, single snapshot, ring order/capacity, report hash relation, generations, selection/mapping/rubric identities and plan identity; a valid state resumes even when logs and the report are entirely absent. missing_report regenerates deterministically with recovery provenance and leaves planning authority unchanged.
checks.oracle: Resume with only compact state and no report/log produces a safe deterministic outcome.

checks.proof: Stale report metadata/projection mismatch emits EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_REPORT_STALE, keeps state authoritative, regenerates when consistent or refuses finalization otherwise. Missing/corrupt authoritative state fails closed typed (EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_STATE_MISSING / _CORRUPT): report or logs alone never restore authority; re-resolution precedes planning. Stale identity (generation/schema/selection/mapping/rubric/dimension/manifest/inventory/config) blocks resume, invokes the resolver, and leaves old plan/state immutable.
checks.oracle: Mismatched or forged report cannot mutate authority; unsupported versions fail closed without approximation.

checks.proof: Retention is structurally bounded: one current snapshot, latest-32 monotonic ring, one retained finalized report per run; logs are best-effort telemetry outside the authority path, so no durable structure grows with run length or event count.
checks.oracle: Long-running run with unbounded telemetry keeps constant-size authoritative state.

checks.proof: Normalization resolves separators/dot segments, rejects traversal escaping project root, stores project-relative forward-slash paths, and replaces absolute/home/outside/symlink-escape/ambiguous references with non-reversible opaque stable IDs/hashes before persistence; raw paths are never retained and cannot cross projects.
checks.oracle: Traversal, symlink, absolute and outside-repository injections leave no forbidden raw path in any durable artifact.

checks.proof: Allowed across durability: normalized repo-relative paths, opaque stable IDs, sha256/hash values, typed enum/status/count metadata. Forbidden everywhere: absolute/home paths, ../ traversal, secrets and credentials, plaintext capability/dispatch/advance tokens, raw command arguments, unrelated prompts/task prose/personal content, full environment dumps. Secret scanner/path validator runs before state, report, event, telemetry, handoff and error persistence; violation rejects or replaces with opaque ID/hash (EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_REDACTION_VIOLATION) so no raw value survives any serialized output.
checks.oracle: Inject tokens, raw args, prompts and exception chains into every surface, then scan all durable/log outputs: zero forbidden values, fail-closed on attempt.

checks.proof: LegacyTierScanner.v1 walks only schema-declared typed surfaces (config fields, input request fields, persisted workflow state fields, output/artifact fields) recursively through nested objects, arrays, unions and versioned envelopes; it never scans prompts, comments, source text, free-form rationale, personal content or telemetry for keywords. It runs after typed parse and redaction but before option ranking, rubric evaluation, shape discovery or plan creation.
checks.oracle: Place legacy terms in every untyped surface: zero matches; only typed persisted values affect D3-A.

checks.proof: The recursive rule covers nested persisted state and versioned envelopes; any exact minimal/pragmatic/clean value in a typed surface returns LEGACY_TIER_UNSUPPORTED before planning with surface, schema_id/version, typed_pointer, redacted source identity, persisted_generation when applicable and actionable core-rubric migration dimensions. Clean cutover removes the vocabulary from config/input schema, output, state, docs and tests with no alias, preset, mapping, ranking or deprecation path.
checks.oracle: minimal/pragmatic/clean nested in input or persisted state blocks planning pre-ranking with a typed pointer; never mapped, ranked or deferred.

checks.proof: Identical strings in untyped prompts, free-form rationale, comments or unrelated prose cannot trigger the scanner, select a workflow or affect rubric scores.
checks.oracle: Prose containing legacy terms produces no rejection and no score effect.

checks.proof: Only versioned typed schemas parse (config/input/state/output/rubric/bundle declarations). Unsupported or ambiguous versions of state, report, manifest, rubric or dimension schemas fail closed with typed errors; there is no silent downgrade, approximation or heuristic compatibility mode anywhere in D7-C/D3-A surfaces.
checks.oracle: Mixed-version ambiguity yields a typed reject naming schema and version, never a heuristic downgrade.

checks.proof: Core owns mandatory non-overridable SituationalRubricRegistry.v1 with exactly scope, risk, reversibility, uncertainty, coupling, blast_radius, cost, evidence_quality; ordinal-score-v1 integer 0..4 with declared per-dimension directions normalized to attention priority, fixed weight=1 each; aggregation core-mean-v1 = sum(normalized priority scores)/8 with tie-breakers mandatory risk class, critical-path depth, phase order, stable ID; every dimension requires typed evidence refs plus non-empty rationale and the aggregate requires aggregate_rationale validated by ranking_rationale_hash over canonical scores/evidence/ordering; safety boundary independent so ranking can never authorize or weaken a checkpoint.
checks.oracle: Missing/duplicate dimension, invalid scale/direction/evidence, missing rationale, or hash mismatch rejects evaluation before planning.

checks.proof: A bundle may only add a fully-qualified versioned dimension bundle/<bundle_id>/rubric/<dimension_id> declaring namespace, ids, version, schema, scale, direction, evidence contract, dimension_hash, manifest_hash and catalog_version; FQNs are unique across accepted bundles and sorted for hashing. Forbidden operations: remove/rename/redefine/reweight/shadow/merge or bypass core safety/checkpoint semantics; bundle metadata never grants permission or remaps model roles.
checks.oracle: Override, shadow or under-declared addition is an invalid declaration rejected before binding.

checks.proof: Fail-closed set: namespace/FQN collision between bundles, incompatible bundle version or engine range, missing metadata/evidence contract/hash, core override/remove/reweight/shadow attempt, dimension or registry hash drift. No automatic rename, merge, reweight or safe-mode substitution exists.
checks.oracle: Load colliding/spoofed/drifted/permissive bundles: typed fail-closed rejection naming bundle/namespace/dimension and conflict.

checks.proof: rubric_hash, core_dimension_hash and accepted_bundle_dimension_schema_hash are required members of EffectiveConfig selection identity, resume identity, WorkDecompositionPlan identity, launch recomputation and stale/replan provenance. Drift after planning triggers transition rubric_or_dimension_drift -> stale_rejected: old plan immutable, launch/resume refused, correction via deterministic new plan only.
checks.oracle: Bundle swap, rubric downgrade or plan substitution during resume cannot resume; drift names each changed identity and forces deterministic replan.
